families.rationale: Lakonishok and Lee's net purchase ratio: issuers whose insiders are net buyers over six months outperform (Lakonishok and Lee, 2001; Jeng, Metrick and Zeckhauser, 2003).
Among names with an insider purchase this quarter, the largest buying relative to the name's own turnover; names without a purchase have no score (NaN, ineligible).
Non-routine (opportunistic) purchases carry the information (Cohen, Malloy and Pomorski, 2012); routine buyers are excluded by the same-month-of-the-prior-year rule.
Purchases by two or more insiders in one quarter are the strongest (Alldredge and Blank, 2019); a name without a cluster has no score.
The most recently filed purchase first: the information is freshest the day it is filed.
Buying relative to turnover, only where a purchase was filed within the last ten sessions.
Contrarian purchases after a decline are the profitable ones (Jeng, Metrick and Zeckhauser, 2003); only names with a negative twenty-session return are scored.
The declared weak prior: among names with insider sales, the lightest relative to turnover (sales are mostly liquidity-driven and uninformative, and most recent sales are plan trades).

rationale: This protocol exists to build and pin the cohort-xu label cube for the a priori insider v2 breadth replication (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-14-insider-breadth-replication-design.md). It is cohort3-insider-v1 with exactly two changes: the cohort (cohort xu: ranks 1-400 and 1,401-2,156 of the same screen-v3 ranking on the 2026-10-15 snapshot, 1,156 names, disjoint from cohort v3) and the corporate-actions acquisition that matches it. Bracket, eligibility (absolute $5 million 20-session median dollar-volume floor, $10 price), 15 bp decisive cost, windows and every other parameter are unchanged, so the cube spec identity equals cohort v3's. The pooled insider fixed sets stay retired: no campaign runs on this protocol. Survivorship: listed and active on 2026-10-15, not point-in-time, delisted names absent (stronger for the small/mid band).
title: Insider pooled protocol on cohort xu (ranks 1-400 and 1,401-2,156 of the cohort-v3 ranking, disjoint from cohort v3): the cohort3-insider-v1 protocol with only the cohort and its corporate actions changed, the vehicle for the cohort-xu label cube and the a priori insider v2 breadth replication; the pooled insider campaign is retired and never runs on it
